words.preconditions: A fresh RFQ event, published, with one QA vendor invited; bidding open for about 20 minutes.
steps: Wait until the round's bid end time has passed.
The invited QA vendor places a complete bid of 100 (open, price, submit).
The buyer reads the pricing round.
As the buyer, read the pricing round and check that Data check: “status” equals active.
words.expected: The app accepts it. Read back afterwards: Data check: “status” equals active.
